resources.string: Choose at least 15 minutes. An earlier end time continues into the next day.
Saving does not start focus. Apply this rule from home, then start when you arrive during its daily window.
Location unavailable. Check precise location and device location settings, try another search, or enter coordinates.
Search uses your device geocoding service. Showing the map sends the viewed area and IP address to OpenStreetMap. Your saved place stays on this device.
Move the map to place the crosshair. Arrival requires a fresh, precise location within about 150 m.
Start focus when you arrive. Location is checked again before blocking.
Create or apply a rule below to get started.
Last check: %1$d m away · accuracy ±%2$d m
Saved changes are not applied yet.
Choose a duration and apps. Quick focus works anywhere, without a saved place.
Turn on place monitoring for arrival and exit alerts. Monitoring shows a persistent notification, never starts focus automatically, and stops when you restore access.
You can always restore access. Android allows you to revoke access or uninstall Offzone. Focus ends if its service stops; split-screen and picture-in-picture can limit app shielding.
Delete “%1$s”? Its active focus will end.
